panels.title: Web Service Payloads - HTTP Requests & Responses

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  timestamp,
  event_type,
  ip_address,
  brand,
  username,
  COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.request_path'), 'No path') as request_path,
  COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.request_method'), 'No method') as request_method,
  COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.response_code'), 'No code') as response_code,
  CASE 
    WHEN JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.request') IS NOT NULL THEN JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.request')
    ELSE 'No request data' 
  END as request_data,
  CASE 
    WHEN JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.response') IS NOT NULL THEN LEFT(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.response'), 200) 
    ELSE 'No response data' 
  END as response_data,
  message
FROM service_logs 
WHERE payload IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC 
LIMIT 100;

panels.title: Cowrie Service Detailed Payloads - Filtered by Event Type

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  timestamp,
  event_type,
  ip_address,
  brand,
  username,
  COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.input'), JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.command'), 'No command') as command,
  COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.outfile'), JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.filename'), JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.file_path'), 'No path') as file_path,
  COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.size'), JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.file_size'), 'No size') as file_size,
  COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.geoip_country'), 'No country') as geoip_country,
  COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.geoip_city'), 'No city') as geoip_city,
  CASE 
    WHEN JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.session') IS NOT NULL THEN JSON_OBJECT('session_id', JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.session'), 'duration', JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.duration'), 'ttylog', JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.ttylog'), 'sensor', JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.sensor'))
    WHEN JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.session_data') IS NOT NULL THEN JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.session_data')
    ELSE 'No session data' 
  END as session_data,
  CASE 
    WHEN JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.ttylog') IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('TTY Log: ', JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.ttylog'), ' (', COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.size'), 'unknown'), ' bytes)')
    WHEN JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.command_output') IS NOT NULL THEN LEFT(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.command_output'), 200)
    ELSE 'No command output' 
  END as command_output,
  message
FROM service_logs 
WHERE payload IS NOT NULL AND (event_type LIKE '%ssh%' OR event_type LIKE '%session%' OR event_type LIKE '%command%' OR event_type LIKE '%login%' OR event_type LIKE '%cowrie%') AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC 
LIMIT 100;
